title: SPIRITWRAK
author: D. S. Yu
description:
Set in the universe of Zork, this game starts off in a monastery. The evil Anabais fools Brother Joseph into releasing him from his prison. He shatters the Rod of the Ancients, and the only way to save the order is to retrieve all the pieces and even confront the Implementors themselves...
[--blurb from The Z-Files Catalogue]
